entries.title: Every app card takes a typed reply
entries.body: Some cards the app puts up itself, such as Allow writes on GitHub? for a crewmate that reads outside issues and Sign in to GitHub again, had no reply field, so you could only press a button. Now every card has the field except the welcome and the cards shown while your first mate is down. A reply on an approval card reaches the crewmate that asked; on any other app card, your first mate answers it.

picture.alt: The Allow writes on GitHub? card with its reply field above Not now and Only this time
